slides.heading: How you know it worked
items: Executable tests: pytest or npm test exit codes on held-out tasks per class, comparing local and incumbent pass rates with Wilson 95% CIs.
Public benchmark harnesses: reruns of 50 Terminal-Bench and 50 SWE-bench Verified tasks on the local model, compared with Qwen's and DeepSeek's self-reported figures.
